classes.name: Warrior
classes.subtitle: Heavy hitting slow tank, melee, pure armor.
classes.description: A master of brute force and resilience. Warriors excel at close-quarters combat, trading powerful blows with their enemies while shrugging off damage with impenetrable heavy armor and high health.
classes.recommendedStats: Focus on Strength, Armour, and Maximum Life. Prioritize Melee Damage and Stun to control the battlefield while withstanding heavy blows.

classes.name: Ranger
classes.subtitle: Squishy fast, normal damage, ranged, pure evasion.
classes.description: Quick, lethal, and precise. Rangers dominate from a distance, using their superior movement speed and pure evasion to effortlessly dodge incoming attacks while landing deadly critical strikes.
classes.recommendedStats: Focus on Dexterity, Evasion Rating, and Movement Speed. Prioritize Attack Speed, Ranged Damage, and Critical Strike Chance to maximize your bow skills.

classes.name: Mercenary
classes.subtitle: Tactical hybrid, crossbows, armor and evasion.
classes.description: A ruthless tactician who fights for profit. Mercenaries utilize specialized ammunition and dirty tactics, balancing sturdy armor to mitigate hits with high evasion to dodge them entirely.
classes.recommendedStats: Focus on a balance of Strength and Dexterity, granting both Armour and Evasion Rating. Prioritize Ranged Damage and Attack Speed.

classes.name: Monk
classes.subtitle: Highly mobile, fast melee combos, evasion and energy shield.
classes.description: A disciplined martial artist. Monks weave between enemies with lightning-fast strikes, utilizing a mystical energy shield to absorb initial blows and high evasion to dodge the rest.
classes.recommendedStats: Focus on Dexterity and Intelligence, boosting Evasion Rating and Maximum Energy Shield. Prioritize Attack Speed, Mobility, and Elemental or Physical Melee Damage for fluid combat combinations.

classes.name: Witch
classes.subtitle: Fragile spellcaster, dark magic, pure energy shield.
classes.description: A master of the dark arts. Witches wield devastating occult magic and rely entirely on a robust mystical energy shield to absorb damage, foregoing physical armor entirely.
classes.recommendedStats: Focus on Intelligence and Maximum Energy Shield. Prioritize Spell Damage, and Void or Elemental Damage to overwhelm foes with dark magic.

classes.name: Death Knight
classes.subtitle: Unstoppable juggernaut, melee, armor and energy shield.
classes.description: A fearsome armored warrior of the undead. Death Knights blend heavy melee combat with magic, layering thick armor beneath a dark energy shield to become an unkillable force.
classes.recommendedStats: Focus on Strength and Intelligence, building high Armour and Maximum Energy Shield. Prioritize Maximum Life, Melee Damage, and Spell Damage to seamlessly blend heavy attacks with magic.
